g.onclick: sendPrompt('Describe the individual role page architecture in detail')
g.text: /roles
/[slug]
/roles
· 14+ role cards with: salary range badge, skill tags, difficulty label (no-code / technical / hybrid)
· filter by: category, level, salary range, work type (remote / on-site / async)
· compare mode: select 2 roles → side-by-side diff (salary, skills, timeline, demand)
· "start here" banner for first-time visitors with role finder quiz shortcut
/roles/slug
· role overview: description, salary with context (global / Asia / freelance), demand level
· "day in the life" section — real task examples, not generic descriptions
· required skills list with "learn this" links to glossary or external resource
· tools you need (e.g. Discord / DefiLlama / Dune for CM / DeFi Analyst)
· interview questions (5–10 per role) with sample answers + "what recruiter wants to hear"
· "am I ready?" checklist — sticky sidebar, localStorage, score percentage
/skill-check
· step 1 — background quiz: "who are you right now?" (newbie / dev / community / creator / trader)
· step 2 — 10–15 skill questions specific to selected track
· step 3 — readiness score + gap analysis: "you're 62% ready for CM. focus on X and Y first"
· step 4 — recommended path: roles matched, roadmap link, portfolio checklist link
· save result to localStorage · retake anytime · shareable result card (og image)
/roadmap
· per-role 30-day roadmap: day-by-day checklist with week grouping
· progress bar (localStorage) — user sees % complete each visit
· each day links to relevant glossary terms, tools, or external resources
· visual timeline view (week cards) + compact list view toggle
/interview
· select role → get 10 mock interview questions
· flip card UX: question front → sample answer + "what recruiter wants" on back
· "common mistakes" section per role
· phase 2 (AI): text input → Claude API scores clarity, experience signal, red flags
/portfolio
· "proof of work" checklist per role — what to build before applying
· templates + examples (announcement template, discord SOP, thread format)
· downloadable media kit template for content creators
· checklist progress tracked locally, with share-ready completion badge
/glossary
· 50+ terms with: simple meaning · why it matters · red flag · "used in job: X, Y"
· filter by category (DeFi, NFT, Layer 2, Security, DAO, Infra)
· flashcard mode + quiz mode (multiple choice, 5 questions)
· cross-linked: terms link to relevant roles, roles link to relevant terms
/salary
· bar chart comparing all roles — filter by: global / Asia / junior / senior / freelance / token-comp
· salary context note: "these are global remote ranges. Indonesian market typically X–Y"
· links back to each role page
Next.js · TypeScript · Tailwind — kept as-is. Add: Framer Motion (animations) · localStorage (progress)
Phase 2 additions: Claude API (interview scorer) · email capture via Resend or Loops
